-- Estados sintéticos de Módulo 7; no contienen datos municipales.
DO $qa$
DECLARE
 t constant uuid:='aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa';
 b constant uuid:='bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb';
 r constant uuid:='cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc';
 maker_m constant uuid:='11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';
 maker_p constant uuid:='22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222';
 checker_m constant uuid:='33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333';
 checker_p constant uuid:='44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444';
 maker jsonb:=jsonb_build_object('tenantId',t,'certifiedBindingId',b,'membershipId',maker_m,'actorPersonId',maker_p,'actorSessionId','55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555','actorSessionVersion',1,'releaseSha',repeat('a',40),'roleKey','QA_PREPARER','employmentLinked',true,'capabilities',jsonb_build_array('payroll.monthly_close.read','payroll.monthly_close.prepare'));
 checker jsonb:=jsonb_build_object('tenantId',t,'certifiedBindingId',b,'membershipId',checker_m,'actorPersonId',checker_p,'actorSessionId','66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666','actorSessionVersion',1,'releaseSha',repeat('a',40),'roleKey','QA_CHECKER','employmentLinked',true,'capabilities',jsonb_build_array('payroll.monthly_close.read','payroll.monthly_close.approve','payroll.monthly_close.audit.read'));
 d jsonb; s record; original_decider_m uuid;original_decider_p uuid;
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO payroll_monthly_close_run(id,tenant_id,certified_binding_id,period_month,jurisdiction,release_sha,source_set_sha256,source_aggregates,reconciliation,blocking_issues,reported_earnings_less_retentions_cents,reported_bank_net_cents,difference_cents,mismatch_count,blocking_issue_count,prepared_by_membership_id,prepared_by_person_id)
 VALUES(r,t,b,'2099-01-01','42',repeat('a',40),repeat('b',64),'[{},{},{}]','{}','[]',10000,10000,0,0,0,maker_m,maker_p);
 PERFORM payroll_monthly_close_transition_v1(maker,r,'submit',1,'ready_for_review','ref:77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777','88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888',repeat('1',64));
 SELECT status,version,submitted_at IS NOT NULL submitted,decided_at IS NULL undecided INTO s FROM payroll_monthly_close_run WHERE id=r;
 IF s.status<>'submitted' OR s.version<>2 OR NOT s.submitted OR NOT s.undecided THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'QA_SUBMIT_STATE'; END IF;
 d:=payroll_monthly_close_detail_v1(maker,r);
 IF d#>'{run,allowedCommands}' <> '["cancel"]'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'QA_PREPARER_COMMANDS: %',d; END IF;
 PERFORM payroll_monthly_close_transition_v1(checker,r,'approve',2,'approved_by_checker','ref:99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999','aaaaaaaa-1111-4111-8111-aaaaaaaaaaaa',repeat('2',64));
 SELECT decided_by_membership_id,decided_by_person_id INTO original_decider_m,original_decider_p FROM payroll_monthly_close_run WHERE id=r;
 IF original_decider_m<>checker_m OR original_decider_p<>checker_p THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'QA_APPROVER_NOT_RECORDED'; END IF;
 d:=payroll_monthly_close_detail_v1(checker,r);
 IF d#>'{run,allowedCommands}' <> '["close","annul"]'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'QA_APPROVED_COMMANDS: %',d; END IF;
 PERFORM payroll_monthly_close_transition_v1(checker,r,'close',3,'closed_for_history','ref:aaaaaaaa-2222-4222-8222-aaaaaaaaaaaa','aaaaaaaa-3333-4333-8333-aaaaaaaaaaaa',repeat('3',64));
 SELECT * INTO s FROM payroll_monthly_close_run WHERE id=r;
 IF s.status<>'closed' OR s.version<>4 OR s.close_approved IS DISTINCT FROM true OR s.decided_by_membership_id<>original_decider_m OR s.decided_by_person_id<>original_decider_p THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'QA_CLOSE_LOST_APPROVER'; END IF;
 d:=payroll_monthly_close_detail_v1(checker,r);
 IF d#>'{run,allowedCommands}' <> '["annul"]'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'QA_CLOSED_COMMANDS: %',d; END IF;
 d:=payroll_monthly_close_transition_v1(checker,r,'annul',4,'annulled_by_authority','ref:aaaaaaaa-4444-4444-8444-aaaaaaaaaaaa','aaaaaaaa-5555-4555-8555-aaaaaaaaaaaa',repeat('4',64));
 SELECT * INTO s FROM payroll_monthly_close_run WHERE id=r;
 IF s.status<>'annulled' OR s.version<>5 OR s.close_approved IS DISTINCT FROM false OR s.decided_by_membership_id<>original_decider_m OR s.decided_by_person_id<>original_decider_p THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'QA_ANNUL_LOST_HISTORY'; END IF;
 d:=payroll_monthly_close_transition_v1(checker,r,'annul',4,'annulled_by_authority','ref:aaaaaaaa-4444-4444-8444-aaaaaaaaaaaa','aaaaaaaa-5555-4555-8555-aaaaaaaaaaaa',repeat('4',64));
 IF (d->>'replayed')::boolean IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'QA_ANNUL_REPLAY'; END IF;
 INSERT INTO payroll_monthly_close_run(id,tenant_id,certified_binding_id,period_month,jurisdiction,release_sha,source_set_sha256,source_aggregates,reconciliation,blocking_issues,reported_earnings_less_retentions_cents,reported_bank_net_cents,difference_cents,mismatch_count,blocking_issue_count,prepared_by_membership_id,prepared_by_person_id)
 VALUES('dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd',t,b,'2099-01-01','42',repeat('a',40),repeat('c',64),'[{},{},{}]','{}','[]',10000,10000,0,0,0,maker_m,maker_p);
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM payroll_monthly_close_run WHERE period_month='2099-01-01' AND jurisdiction='42')<>2 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'QA_ANNULLED_DID_NOT_RELEASE_PERIOD'; END IF;
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM payroll_monthly_close_event WHERE run_id=r AND command IN('submit','approve','close','annul'))<>4 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'QA_TIMELINE_COUNT'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payroll_monthly_close_event WHERE run_id=r AND (includes_personal_records OR raw_content_stored OR grh_mutation OR payroll_calculated OR payroll_posted OR bank_artifact_generated OR government_artifact_generated OR fiscal_artifact_generated)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'QA_SIDE_EFFECT_FLAG'; END IF;
 BEGIN DELETE FROM payroll_monthly_close_run WHERE id=r; RAISE EXCEPTION 'QA_DELETE_ALLOWED'; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN IF SQLERRM<>'PAYROLL_MONTHLY_CLOSE_RUN_DELETE_FORBIDDEN' THEN RAISE; END IF; END;
END $qa$;

DO $maker_checker$
DECLARE t uuid:='aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa';b uuid:='bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb';r uuid:='eeeeeeee-eeee-4eee-8eee-eeeeeeeeeeee';m uuid:='11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';p uuid:='22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222';
 ctx jsonb:=jsonb_build_object('tenantId',t,'certifiedBindingId',b,'membershipId',m,'actorPersonId',p,'actorSessionId','55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555','actorSessionVersion',1,'releaseSha',repeat('a',40),'roleKey','QA_PREPARER','employmentLinked',true,'capabilities',jsonb_build_array('payroll.monthly_close.read','payroll.monthly_close.prepare','payroll.monthly_close.approve'));
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO payroll_monthly_close_run(id,tenant_id,certified_binding_id,period_month,jurisdiction,release_sha,source_set_sha256,source_aggregates,reconciliation,blocking_issues,reported_earnings_less_retentions_cents,reported_bank_net_cents,difference_cents,mismatch_count,blocking_issue_count,prepared_by_membership_id,prepared_by_person_id)
 VALUES(r,t,b,'2099-02-01','42',repeat('a',40),repeat('d',64),'[{},{},{}]','{}','[]',10000,10000,0,0,0,m,p);
 PERFORM payroll_monthly_close_transition_v1(ctx,r,'submit',1,'ready_for_review','ref:bbbbbbbb-1111-4111-8111-bbbbbbbbbbbb','bbbbbbbb-2222-4222-8222-bbbbbbbbbbbb',repeat('5',64));
 BEGIN
  PERFORM payroll_monthly_close_transition_v1(ctx,r,'approve',2,'approved_by_checker','ref:bbbbbbbb-3333-4333-8333-bbbbbbbbbbbb','bbbbbbbb-4444-4444-8444-bbbbbbbbbbbb',repeat('6',64));
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'QA_SELF_APPROVAL_ALLOWED';
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN IF SQLERRM<>'PAYROLL_MONTHLY_CLOSE_MAKER_CHECKER_REQUIRED' THEN RAISE; END IF; END;
END $maker_checker$;
DO $done$ BEGIN RAISE NOTICE 'MODULE7_QA: lifecycle, history, idempotency and maker-checker passed'; END $done$;
